definition.question: How do plasmon mixing and pion-induced KK-graviton production affect stellar cooling limits, and when can intra-tower decays reduce limits from Standard Model decay products?
definition.summary: Cooling and subsequent decay signals are distinct constraint mechanisms. The source studies additional production channels and a conditional change in branching to visible products across more than one extra-dimensional setting.

systems: Stellar plasmas
Supernova cores
KK gravitons in large extra dimensions
targets: Energy-loss limits
Production mechanisms
Dependence of visible-decay limits on intra-tower decays
assumptions: Weakening visible-decay bounds requires intra-tower decays to dominate.
Pion abundance and properties in protoneutron stars are uncertain.
conventions: Cooling and bounds from later Standard Model decays remain separate.
includes: Bremsstrahlung comparison
Plasmon mixing
π−p → nh
excludes: Completed white-dwarf constraints
Assuming rapid intra-tower decays in every geometry

definition.title: What do repeated KK decays do to linear structure?
definition.question: Within the specified repeated-decay KK-graviton model, how do daughter recoil and the changing mass distribution affect linear cosmological perturbations?
definition.summary: Repeated decays change the tower mass distribution and give daughters recoil velocities. The linear cosmology calculation assumes a specified decay history and does not establish the cascade microphysics.

systems: A cosmological KK-graviton dark-matter tower
targets: Linear matter and CMB perturbations
Recoil constraints and their conditional parameter interpretation
regimes: Source-era CMB, BAO and cosmic-shear analysis
assumptions: Repeated intra-tower decay evolution
Simplified daughter distribution dominated by approximately symmetric decays
Small released mass difference
conventions: The source's kick parameter is a combination of model parameters
Its reported confidence limit is a dated author result
includes: Daughter recoil
Changing mass population
Conditional structure suppression
excludes: Nonlinear structure predictions or a demonstrated resolution of the S8 tension
Unconditional viability of the cascade
Visible-energy injection as the primary target
